LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.QuestDescription:
{0} offers to join your colony as an ordinary free colonist to work in the complex. This offer remains valid for {1} days.
Terms of agreement: 1. Until a suitable assignment in the complex is granted, their mood will suffer a penalty of -50 due to broken promises. 2. Once assigned any regular role (cook, waiter, doctor, host, or cleaner), they receive an initial mood boost of +15, which gradually declines to +10 and +5. The adaptation period ends after 15 in-game days. 3. Participation in paid conversations with guests is strictly voluntary: declining an individual conversation carries no penalty and does not revoke their employee status.
{0} will become a full colonist upon arrival.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.Arrived: {0} arrives to work in the complex
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.ArrivedHelp: {0} joins the colony as a regular colonist. Assign a regular role in the staff menu at the reception desk to prevent a severe mood drop.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.WaitingDescription: I was promised steady work in the complex, but I still have not been assigned a suitable role. I feel deceived and useless.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.Settled15Description: I was assigned work in the complex, just as promised. It feels great to be occupied and needed in my new home.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.Settled10Description: I am getting used to my duties and the routine of the complex. Work is proceeding smoothly.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.Settled5Description: Working in the complex has become a familiar part of everyday colony life for me.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.NoComplex: There is no configured active complex with designated territory and a reception desk.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.NoSuitableWork: The colonist has no enabled regular work or suitable role in the complex.
LanguageData.TMM.Recruit.CandidateUnavailable: The candidate or map is unavailable; the recruitment offer cannot be fulfilled.
